_doc: Multi-hop / comparison / global retrieval eval over the bundled Mathematics and Operating System PDFs. Each question has SEVERAL gold anchors that live in DIFFERENT chunks (a retrieved chunk covers an anchor when its normalised text contains it); metrics: hit@k (any anchor), multi-recall@k (share of anchors covered). split dev/test: knobs are tuned on dev only, test is reported untouched. Questions derived by reading the chunks.
